quotations: Bridging the divide between deterministic physics-based control and policy-driven adaptation, Boston Dynamics released a video today showing its Atlas humanoid using wheels to move around. The “experiment” combined classical model-based motor control with whole-body reinforcement learning to maintain dynamic stability across unstructured, real-world terrain.
Boston Dynamics said “a wheeled Atlas isn’t a product. It’s a research testbed.” Wu’s intention was to push the actuation to its limits.
